meta.title: About — Crucible
meta.description: What Crucible is, why it exists, and where it's going.

hero.headline: Don't compete. Complete.
hero.subheadline: Crucible is a Developer Experience infrastructure platform — a collection of focused open-source tools that eliminate friction developers face with AI assistant configuration management across tools, repos, and teams.

metaphor.heading: The metallurgy metaphor
metaphor.description: A crucible is the vessel where raw materials are refined under pressure into something useful. Every product name maps to a stage in the metalworking process.

items.name: Forge
items.description: — Shape raw materials into useful tools (CLI that shapes configs)

items.name: Smelt
items.description: — Extract pure metal from ore (shared plugin engine library)

items.name: Anvil
items.description: — The surface you build on (SDK for third-party plugins)

items.name: Lathe
items.description: — Precision shaping tool (MCP server wrapping forge commands)

items.name: Foundry
items.description: — Where you cast finished goods (plugin registry/marketplace)

items.name: Ember
items.description: — The glow that shows where heat is (AI observability)

items.title: Don't compete, complete
items.description: Build the cross-tool coordination layer that no single AI vendor will build. Complement every tool, compete with none.

items.title: DX is the whole product
items.description: If it's not delightful to use, it doesn't ship. Developer experience isn't a feature — it's the product itself.

items.title: Build for the final vision from day one
items.description: Architecture supports the endgame even when shipping an MVP. No throwaway scaffolding.

items.title: Speed over completeness
items.description: Ship narrow, iterate fast. A working tool today beats a perfect tool next quarter.

items.title: Community is the moat
items.description: Open source. MIT license. Community contributions outscale any solo effort.

items.title: Cross-tool is the structural advantage
items.description: No AI vendor will solve the multi-tool problem. The value is in the space between tools.

items.title: Platform outlasts any individual tool
items.description: AI tools will come and go. The coordination infrastructure persists.

roadmap.heading: Product roadmap
roadmap.footer: Architecture: platform of focused CLIs sharing @crucibledx/smelt. See {link}.

architecture.heading: Path C: Platform of CLIs
architecture.description: Three architecture paths were evaluated: a god-mode universal CLI, separate CLIs with no shared code, or a platform of focused CLIs sharing a plugin infrastructure library. Path C won.
architecture.diagramAlt: Crucible Ecosystem — Platform of focused CLIs
architecture.caption: Each product is independent enough to be useful alone, but shares infrastructure for engineering leverage, community cohesion, and a defensible moat.
